project.name: sultan-portfolio
project.productType: Developer portfolio with product films and engineering case studies

design.colorMode: system with persisted light and dark overrides

typography.display: Sofia Sans Condensed 700; clamp(64px, 11vw, 168px), .88 line height, -.02em tracking
typography.meta: JetBrains Mono 400/500 via next/font; 12px uppercase with .12em tracking

motion.implementation: CSS and IntersectionObserver; native scrolling; rAF-throttled rail fills; one-time numeral count-up
motion.playback: Always enabled per the latest user request; no pause controls, hover pauses or reduced-motion override. Suspend only hidden/offscreen work.

design.density: Launch tape: asymmetric 7/5 hero with reel, sticky editorial chapters, supporting index table, dark bento, timeline, horizontal process, crossed-tape finale

patterns: Transparent header switches to paper after 24px; one shared sliding ribbon indicator follows section IntersectionObserver state; native full-screen mobile navigation dialog

Hero: 7/5 composition with accent headline and 400ms tape underline; rotated three-card reel opens a native film dialog; mobile reel is a scroll-snap carousel; exact production metrics count up once; core-stack marquee ends the hero
Four sticky project chapters: KazEcoFood, Agentic Ops, ATU Campus, StratWeb; outlined chapter numbers, dark film frames, evidence and key points; before/after DOCX output metrics
Supporting work is an index table with original descriptions, features, source/access links and videos retained in disclosures

Dark five-category bento with project filters; categories use the existing project mapping and exact technology intersections; unrelated text uses AA-safe dark-muted while decorative borders dim to 35%
Experience timeline fills an ember rail; four desktop process steps share a stepped horizontal ribbon connector and become a vertical rail on mobile

Contact keeps Get in touch and existing copy; crossed marquee tape sits behind the finale; giant email link with 1.5-second copy confirmation; social index includes only Email, Telegram and GitHub, numbered 01–03
Footer: decorative 8% opacity full-name wordmark, current year, original contact links and Back to top

must: Preserve all existing copy, facts, metrics, links, videos, captions, transcripts and resume. Never invent claims.
Keep --bg/--ink/--accent and existing warm paper/ink tokens; flat surfaces, hairlines, radius 0–6px.
Sofia Sans Condensed display, Golos Text body, JetBrains Mono metadata via next/font.
Gradients only on tape; at most one dominant tape motif per viewport. No purple, indigo or blue-violet portfolio chrome.
KazEcoFood ember; Agentic Ops ink; ATU Campus sand; StratWeb pitch; supporting projects ember at 60% opacity.
Preserve system/light/dark storage and system-preference behavior.
Visible SSR baseline; video preload none, user-initiated playback, native controls, single active video, downloads, captions and transcripts.
CSS + IntersectionObserver only. Motion is always enabled per the latest user request, without pause controls. Inspect desktop and mobile in the browser.
avoid: Gradient section fills, glows, blur, decorative shadows, large-radius cards
Changing factual project data or links
Adding an animation runtime for this redesign

decisions: Stage 02: one coherent light system with semantic CSS colors and 48–88px section spacing.
Reuse ActionLink, SectionLabel and hydration-safe Reveal; use compact Project Index row composition as inspiration for supporting work.
Agentic Ops is a basic featured overview with an actual sample screenshot, KazEcoFood a major overview, and remaining work compact rows.
Stage 03: server-rendered AI Product Developer Hero; asymmetric desktop composition, stacked tablet, real approval-inbox evidence with explicit sample status and mobile art direction.
Hero uses existing Framer Motion only for a short post-hydration transform entrance; no hidden SSR copy, looping backgrounds or pointer parallax. Preview links to the existing Agentic Ops overview.

Stage 04 (2026-10-08): the review-queue direction replaces the Stage 02 violet editorial system. The palette comes from the Agentic Ops product tokens; the hero is a sentence headline plus a playable approval card in place of the screenshot.
Framer Motion, lucide-react, Reveal, ScrollProgress and HeroEntrance are removed. Section eyebrows and project numbering are gone; numbers stay only on the How I work steps.

2026-10-21: product films for Agentic Ops (1:30) and ATU Campus (1:54) replace the simulated approval hero. Both get native video players, verified Russian captions, transcripts and static case studies.

Core stack is TypeScript, JavaScript, Python and PostgreSQL. Skill groups link to the local projects that demonstrate their use. ATU is a demo project and its AI grading sequence is explicitly a future feature concept.

2026-10-22: Agentic Ops, ATU Campus and StratWeb share a compact three-film index in the hero and framed native players in featured editorial rows. Film frames use existing light surfaces, a blue circular play action, duration and available captions. Feature lists expand on demand to keep the films in focus. StratWeb has a static case study and a 1080p60 faststart showreel with music, no narration.

2026-10-22: user-selected section rhythm adds a feathered dark skills band and primary-soft process band. Hero gains an availability pill, exact production proof and six monochrome framework marks; films share dark frames. Secondary video resources collapse into disclosures. Contact gains a subtle gradient border. System/light/dark preferences persist under toksoz-theme; Golos Text and Sofia Sans Condensed remain unchanged. Project data and all original project facts, copy and numbers are preserved.

2026-10-22: color-only editorial rework replaces the previous palette with warm paper, warm black and restrained vermilion. All layout, copy, fonts and content stay intact. Remove decorative effects and shadows; use hairlines, square status markers and neutral process surfaces. Keep original project media and static OG artwork unchanged; recolor code-native OG output and favicon tokens.

2026-10-22: user-selected full Launch tape redesign supersedes earlier color-only and no-mono/no-numbering constraints. New composition, fluid typography, project ribbon identities, mobile navigation and restrained CSS/IntersectionObserver motion. Existing product content, media, links and theme logic are preserved. 21st inspiration search returned HTTP 401; reused project primitives and implemented the explicit user direction. Browser checks cover 320–1440px, both themes, reduced motion, six players, navigation and case studies.

2026-10-22: user supplied sections 3–4 of Launch tape. Apply the exact reel/chapter/index/bento/timeline/process/finale composition, replacing the earlier film list and skill rows. Preserve all factual data and project media. Native dialogs provide focus containment and Escape; native scrolling and CSS/IntersectionObserver handle motion. Project videos pause on unmount. Count-up text is decorative with stable final accessible labels. Copy feedback lasts 1.5 seconds.

2026-10-22: final responsive and accessibility requirements take precedence over 35% text opacity: preserve AA-readable filtered text and apply 35% only to decorative borders. Focus rings use 2px accent outlines with 2px offset; all authored controls are at least 44px. Expose each marquee message once. Retain the 8% footer wordmark as decorative SVG artwork. Supporting video posters are extracted from the original films; factual data and original media stay unchanged.

2026-10-22: user requested subtle canvas star-field atmosphere without other design changes. Add hydration-gated StarField at the root and a clipped dark instance in skills. Area-based density, DPR <=2, 30fps, stable theme-switched positions, crystal flares and desktop dark-only shooting stars. Cache gradients and document masks outside the animation loop; pause hidden/offscreen canvases. Reduced motion draws a static field, with a conservative uniform mask on the fixed canvas to retain contrast while native scrolling needs no repaint. User-requested dark crystal glow is an explicit exception to ribbon-only gradients.

2026-10-22: latest user instruction supersedes reduced-motion and hover-pause behavior. Visible ribbons and stars always animate, with no global or ribbon pause controls. Remove motion preference storage and ignore previously saved choices. Preserve the theme toggle, native video controls and hidden/offscreen resource savings.

2026-10-27: LeadPilot AI joins Selected work and the hero as a fourth product film. Reuse ProjectVideo, FilmReel, ProjectOverview and the shared case-study route. The final 60s 1080p60 trailer is copied byte-for-byte from the last production session; its 58s brand frame supplies the poster. Cobalt is scoped to the new project ribbon and play control as an extension of project identities; warm portfolio chrome stays unchanged. Extend the reel spacing and mobile carousel to four cards, derive index numbers from data, and include the project in stack filters. Working-prototype copy describes one verified synthetic live integration scenario without claiming sales outcomes or a public release.
